claim: ClinicalTrials.gov is an external website and online database of clinical research studies and information about their results.
future_grounding_route: Trial records can seed acquisition or mechanistic context, but trial claims require protocol/result inspection and cannot alter project findings without grounding.
project_use: MS intervention/trial landscape navigation and potential cohort-source discovery.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Registry/result records for ongoing and completed clinical studies, including MS drug and biomarker studies.
why_unverifiable: Clinical trial registry records and submitted results are external and must be independently interpreted or linked to data before project use.
